title: Buy a data call
setup: An approved data provider charges an illustrative $0.02. The sponsor allows at most $1 today.

steps.title: Request data
steps.detail: The agent asks the service for a specified resource.
steps.boundary: No payment permission follows from discovering a URL.
steps.failure: A malicious endpoint can ask for more than the intended task.

steps.title: Read the quote
steps.detail: The 402 response describes amount, token, network, recipient and expiry.
steps.boundary: The server names its price; it cannot grant spending authority.
steps.failure: A stale quote or wrong network should stop this attempt.

steps.title: Check permission
steps.detail: A wallet policy checks provider, amount and remaining budget before signing.
steps.boundary: This is the boundary before money is committed.
steps.failure: An over-budget attempt is rejected even if the agent asks confidently.

steps.title: Pay and retry
steps.detail: Signed payment data accompanies the retry; the server or optional facilitator verifies and settles.
steps.boundary: A valid signature and a settled transfer are different states.
steps.failure: Use receipt matching and idempotency; do not blindly pay again after a timeout.

steps.title: Check the result
steps.detail: The agent checks format and usefulness and saves the receipt.
steps.boundary: The payment receipt does not certify factual accuracy.
steps.failure: Missing or incorrect data needs application-level recovery and refund terms.

title: Check out a cart
setup: A shopper chooses goods through an assistant. The merchant owns inventory, fulfillment and support.

steps.title: Build the cart
steps.detail: Retrieve current stock, options, shipping and tax.
steps.boundary: The merchant is the authoritative source of the quote.
steps.failure: Out-of-stock items or price changes invalidate stale assumptions.

steps.title: Approve purchase
steps.detail: The shopper approves the final cart and total, or a precise prior mandate permits it.
steps.boundary: A recommendation is not permission to buy.
steps.failure: A changed purchase outside the mandate needs renewed approval.

steps.title: Scope credentials
steps.detail: Use a merchant-, amount- or time-limited credential where the integration supports it.
steps.boundary: The assistant should not receive unrestricted card secrets.
steps.failure: Scope or expiry mismatches stop the purchase.

steps.title: Authorize payment
steps.detail: The merchant submits the order and requests payment authorization.
steps.boundary: Authorization, capture and bank payout occur at different stages.
steps.failure: A card decline or duplicate order needs a safe retry policy.

steps.title: Fulfill and support
steps.detail: The merchant ships, reports status and handles returns and refunds.
steps.boundary: The order receipt is not proof of delivery.
steps.failure: Late delivery follows merchant and network dispute rules.

title: Hire another agent
setup: A buyer agent commissions a research deliverable under an approved budget and explicit acceptance criteria.

steps.title: Define success
steps.detail: Specify the deliverable, deadline and acceptance tests.
steps.boundary: A vague job cannot become objectively good just by putting it onchain.

steps.title: Agree terms
steps.detail: Confirm the provider, price, evaluator and permitted budget.
steps.boundary: Approval must happen before funds are committed.
steps.failure: An unauthorized provider or changed terms must stop the job.

steps.title: Fund escrow
steps.detail: Reserve payment under the contract rules.
steps.boundary: Reserved money is not money already paid to the provider.
steps.failure: Contract errors and unsupported assets remain risks.

steps.title: Evaluate delivery
steps.detail: The provider submits work; buyer or evaluator checks the agreed criteria.
steps.boundary: Evaluation supplies a judgment, not guaranteed truth.
steps.failure: Evaluator error, collusion and unusable work are possible.

steps.title: Resolve the job
steps.detail: Approval releases payment; rejection or expiry follows the actual implementation.
steps.boundary: There is no universal refund promise across all job protocols.
steps.failure: Read the release, dispute and timeout rules before funding.
